info.name: ACK St. Mary's Kabete LMS - API Gateway
info.description: Full route coverage for the api-gateway (port 8000), with a pm.test() assertion block on every request. Run 'Auth > Login' first - it has an auto-listener test script that captures {{access_token}}/{{refresh_token}} automatically, so every other request (Bearer auth is inherited at the collection level) just works. Tests use realistic status-code allowlists (e.g. [200, 403, 404]) so the collection can run green against a freshly-seeded/empty database, while still failing loudly on a genuine 500/502 — that's how this collection caught real backend bugs during development. Routes marked 'placeholder stub' return {status: placeholder_stub} - real logic hasn't been ported from the old Django views yet, so seeding data for those does nothing. For the real endpoints (students/guardians/admissions/academics/clubs/transport/finance/fingerprint), apply scripts/seed_dev_data.sql first — the id-shaped collection variables (student_id, class_id, academic_year_id, etc.) default to that script's fixed ids, so any single GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE-by-id request works standalone without first running a chain of 'Create' requests. Running the full collection top-to-bottom still works too — each 'Create' overwrites these with a freshly-generated id for that run, and Cleanup deletes them at the end. If you've done a full run, these variables may now point at deleted ids; re-apply the seed script and either reset the variables to the values above or re-import the collection to get back to standalone-testable state.
